title: Register a new student account and reach the dashboard
description: This verifies that a new student can create an account, authenticate, and arrive at the dashboard with access to the app shell.

steps.description: Fill in the full name field with a new student name
Fill in the email field with a new student email
Fill in the password field with a valid password

Verify authenticated navigation is available across the app
